episodeTitle.en: Inside Linear: Building with taste, craft, and focus | Karri Saarinen (co-founder, designer, CEO)
episodeTitle.zh: 《Linear内参：用品味、工艺与专注打造设计》|卡里·萨里宁（联合创始人、设计总监、CEO）

guestBioOfficial.en: Karri Saarinen is the co-founder and CEO of Linear, an issue-tracking tool that has quickly become the fastest-growing and most beloved in the world. Before Linear, Karri was the principal designer and co-creator of design systems at Airbnb and the founding designer at Coinbase. In today’s episode, he shares: • How to prioritize craft in product development
guestBioOfficial.zh: 卡里·萨里宁是Linear的联合创始人兼CEO。Linear是一款issue-tracking工具，已迅速成为全球增长最快、最受欢迎的同类产品。在创立Linear之前，卡里曾担任Airbnb的首席设计师和设计系统共同开发者，以及Coinbase的创始设计师。在本期节目中，他将分享：• 如何在产品开发中优先考虑工艺

title.en: Inside Linear: Building with taste, craft, and focus | Karri Saarinen (co-founder, designer, CEO)
title.zh: 《Linear内参：用品味、工艺与专注打造设计》|卡里·萨里宁（联合创始人、设计总监、CEO）

summary.en: Karri argues that as a product category matures, design quality becomes a basic price of entry rather than a differentiator. He describes how Linear builds with extreme focus on craft, speed, and a small, high-agency team. The episode is a master class in building a fast, opinionated, design-led company.
summary.zh: 卡里认为，随着某个产品品类走向成熟，设计质量会从"差异化优势"变成"入场的基本门槛"。他讲述了 Linear 如何通过极度聚焦工艺、速度和一支小型高自驱团队来打造产品。本期堪称构建一家快速、有主张、以设计驱动的公司的大师课。
